The mechanism it validated lives on in zoldonrasib and INCB161734, which are the agents to pursue instead.
next_steps: Do not pursue MRTX1133 directly; the program is closed
Route the same KRAS G12D-selective rationale to zoldonrasib (RASolute 305, NCT07621718) and INCB161734 (DAWN-303, NCT07522073), which carried the mechanism forward

Off-label nivolumab + ipilimumab for MSS PDAC would face prior-authorization denial in most plans, since there is no on-label indication, no NCCN listing, and the MSS / TMB-8.6 profile predicts low benefit from checkpoint blockade. Not a route to pursue on its own.
access_summary: The vaccine itself is a finished single-center academic study with no open slot and no manufacturer to supply it, so the combination as studied is not obtainable. The checkpoint backbone (nivolumab plus ipilimumab) is FDA-approved in other cancers and could in theory be prescribed off-label, but for this MSS, TMB-8.6 tumor that would be low-yield, off-guideline, and very likely denied by payers. The useful read from this row is mechanistic: the immunotherapy route into this tumor runs through KRAS-inhibitor-driven antigen restoration plus checkpoint, not checkpoint or vaccine alone.
next_steps: Do not pursue off-label nivolumab + ipilimumab as a standalone strategy here; the MSS / TMB-8.6 profile predicts low benefit and payers will likely deny it
Confirm MMR protein IHC (MLH1/PMS2/MSH2/MSH6) on tumor tissue before any checkpoint-based claim, per the case's validation gate
Route the checkpoint rationale instead toward KRAS-inhibitor-plus-anti-PD-1 cohorts (e.g. the retifanlimab cohort in INCB161734 NCT06179160)
If a research team wants the academic protocol detail, contact nzaidi1@jhmi.edu

The validation step is ordering ARID1A IHC before pursuing this.

The EZH2 route into this patient's ARID1A axis has lost its lead agent; the ATR route (ceralasertib) is the one still standing.
next_steps: Do not pursue tazemetostat; it has been withdrawn from all markets and all programs are closed
Direct the ARID1A synthetic-lethal rationale to the ATR axis (ceralasertib, NCT03682289) instead
